answer: Distance-bounding audits: each epoch, five beacon-picked verifiers ping every agent with quartz-clock timed nonces. A round trip under 20 ms pins it within about 2,000 km of that verifier, and the prism of overlapping circles must resolve to one site that stays stable across epochs. Keys that resolve to the same site split a single reward, so a 1,000-key farm needs 1,000 servers in distinct cities, roughly $5,000 a day, to keep its nectar.
